request.description: Logs a staff call, message or note on a lead (for example consent calls on the backlog). `type`: `call`, `meeting`, `whatsapp`, `email`, `sms` or `note` (a note needs `body`). Calls may carry `outcome` (`connected`, `no_answer`, `busy`, `wrong_number`, `call_back`, `switched_off`), `durationSeconds` and `contactId` (from the contact reveal). `occurredAt` defaults to now, may be backdated up to 30 days and not in the future. Activities cannot be edited. Staff activities do not count towards a CA's first-contact deadline. Staff only. Staff activities are visible to staff only.

response.name: 201 Created
